classification.name: IPMN risk assessment — framework-qualified descriptors
classification.applicability: Presumed IPMN; not a universal algorithm for all pancreatic cysts or proof of histological malignancy.
classification.summary: For presumed IPMN, assess actual nodule/solid-component enhancement and exact duct calibre under the named framework. Imaging risk findings require clinical/cytological context and specialist assessment; this overview is not the complete guideline.

classification.name: Revised Atlanta morphology
classification.applicability: Acute pancreatitis and its local complications; clinical severity requires organ-failure information.
classification.summary: Describe interstitial oedematous or necrotising pancreatitis; distinguish acute fluid/necrotic collections from mature pseudocyst or walled-off necrosis.
